app.title: RA3 Inventory
app.subtitle: Browse a Lutron RadioRA 3 inventory.
welcome.heading: Welcome to RA3 Inventory
welcome.body: Pair with your RadioRA 3 processor to get started. You'll need to be physically near it to press the pairing button.
startup.loading_body: Checking the local app session before opening your inventory.
startup.auth_body: The app is connected, but this window no longer has a valid session token. Reload the desktop app window and try again.
startup.error_body: The backend responded, but the app couldn't load saved profiles yet.
settings.label: Settings
pair.description: Connect to your RadioRA 3 processor. You'll be prompted to press the small pairing button on the processor during this flow.
pair.stream_lost: Lost connection to the pairing stream.
pair.press_button: Press the pairing button on your processor (front of RA3, back of Caseta) within 30 seconds.
extract.already_connected: Another LEAP client is connected. Close Home Assistant / HomeBridge and retry.
profiles.open_description: Pick the processor profile you want to browse. The active profile is what the inventory and export endpoints will operate on.
profiles.empty: No profiles yet. Pair a processor first.
inventory.empty: No inventory yet — run an extraction to populate.
inventory.no_snapshot_body: Run an extraction to pull the current state from your processor. It takes about 5–10 seconds.
inventory.select_device: Select a device to see its details.
settings.title: Settings
settings.firmware_note: Firmware updates must be initiated from Lutron Designer or the Lutron app. This tool only reports availability.
export.title: Export inventory
export.description: Pick the format and (for Markdown) which sections to include.
export.label: Export
export.verbose_help: Adds hrefs, addressed-state, LocalZones/ButtonGroups columns, and the full button programming-model action chain. Off by default — the slim view is just what you'd need for a factory-reset recovery.
